Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh were doing decently to keep the hosts under 190 but the over from Saifuddin changed the complexion of the game. How ironic that he was the best bowler for the home side until he leaked 31 runs in his final over and Miller then basked in the momentum. Shakib Al Hasan was brilliant with the ball earlier but will rue the poor bowling towards the end. The tour has been a dismal one for the tourists but can they finish on a high? They will be up against it in the chase. Join us in a while for it.

Phew! What an innings, what a brilliant innings from David Miller. 90 runs in the last five overs and South Africa have completely annihilated Bangladesh. Hashim Amla got them off to a flier with a fifty before missing out on the ton. AB de Villiers and JP Duminy could not get going but all was not done. Miller was dropped on 0 by Rahim and he responded with a majestic ton, his first in this format of the game.
Full and outside off, Behardien drives it through covers and Miller comes back for the second well. What a finish. SOUTH AFRICA FINISH ON 224/4!
Fuller in length around middle, turned through mid-wicket for a single.

THERE IT IS! CENTURY FOR MILLER! Fuller outside off, Miller comes forward and drives it through covers and gets a couple of runs. He gets to his maiden T20I ton, the quickest in this format of the game. It has taken him just 35 balls, remember he was dropped on 0. How well has he played? He removes the helmet and acknowledges the applause from the crowd. He has played out of his skin here.
Fuller in length around leg, Miller turns it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Another boundary! Full toss outside off, Miller swings at it but gets an outside edge. The ball runs down into the third man fence for a boundary. He is on 96 now.
FOUR! Fuller outside off, Miller looks to slice it over the covers but gets it squarer and the ball runs into the fence. He is down on the ground but on 92!
Rubel Hossain comes back on for the final over.

Fuller outside off, Miller mistimes his drive through covers for a single. Miller's face says it all, that was asking to be hit but David missed out. 31 runs from the over. Spare a thought for the bowler, he has taken two big wickets but has now been plundered for fives sixes in a row.
Can he do it?

SIX! FIVE SIXES IN A ROW! Short ball comes from Saifuddin but it is not a good one. David Miller waits for it and pulls it over deep square leg for a maximum. That was more of the top edge but still. Can Miller hit another one?
Conference time! Shakib has a word with his bowler. A man goes back on the leg side, at square leg. Short ball coming?

SIX! FOUR IN A ROW! Full and outside leg again, Miller gets across and clips it over the fine leg fence for another biggie. Saifuddin does not know where to go and hides his face inside his jersey. Can David hit 6 in a row?
SIX! Fuller outside leg, Miller gets across and just clips it over backward square leg for a maximum. Three sixes in a row, can Miller hit 6 in 6?
SIX! Oh my god! Full and outside off, David Miller just stands in his crease and lofts it over extra cover for another maximum. He holds the pose for the pictures. 1,000 T20I runs for David Miller!
SIX! Miller, you beauty! Fuller from Saifuddin, Miller waits for it and just launches it over wide long on for another biggie. This is top batting by David.
Slower one outside off, Behardien cannot put it away. Still 15 runs from the over.
Slower one on a fuller length around leg, Miller cannot clip it. The ball deflects off the pads wide of the keeper. A leg bye stolen.
SIX! In the arc, out of the park! Full toss from Taskin, asking to be smashed. Miller gets under it and just crashes it over mid-wicket for a biggie.

FOUR! Played Miller, 2nd T20I fifty for him. Shorter in length outside off, Miller looks to go hard but gets a top edge to fine leg for a boundary. He was dropped on 0 and how well has he made the visitors pay.
WIDE! Slower one gone wrong down the leg side, Miller cannot clip it away.
Low full toss around leg, hit down to long on for a single.
Full toss around off, worked through mid-wicket for a couple of runs by Behardien.
Taskin returns.
Too full around off, hit down to long off for a single. Good over by Saifuddin.
Fuller around middle, turned towards square leg by the batsman.
FOUR! What timing! Low full toss outside off, Miller backs away and drives it through covers. The timing is so good that he gets a boundary.
Farhaan Behardien comes out to bat. He finished well in the last game, can he do it today as well?

OUT! Amla holes out! Slower one outside off, Amla looks to go over mid-wicket with a swipe but fails to connect well. The deep mid-wicket fielder gets under it and takes a good catch. That was well bowled by Saifuddin. He has taken out both Amla and de Villiers today. Sarkar was the man in the deep, taking the catch. End of a terrific knock by the South African opener.
Full and outside off, Amla now looks to paddle it but cannot connect.
Bowls a good yorker around off and middle, Amla can only dig it out from his crease.
Saifuddin called on for a bowl.
SIX! BOOM! Full and asking to be hit, Miller is too good a batsman to miss out and hence carts it over wide long on for a maximum. What an over for the hosts, 23 from it.
WIDE! Bowls it down the leg side, Miller cannot clip it. Wide signaled.
SIX! Length and dismissed! Length ball around off, David Miller gets under it and smashes it over the long on fence for a biggie. The big shots are coming off easily.
FOUR! Go back and bowl! Fuller outside leg, Miller clears his front leg and just clobbers it over mid-wicket for a boundary. He was backing away to go over the off side but adjusted brilliantly.
Punches it through covers for a single.

FOUR! Edged! Shorter in length around off, Amla flashes hard at it. The ball goes off the edge and flies past the keeper for a boundary. This is now the highest individual score by a South African vs Bangladesh in T20Is.

NOT OUT! Miller is safely in! Length around middle and leg, Miller works it towards mid on and takes off for a single. Shakib gets to the ball and scores a direct hit at the bowler's end. The players appeal and it is referred upstairs. Replays though find Miller safe. He bats on.
Direct hits are always interesting and there is one at the bowler's end. Is Miller short of his crease?
Another change. Rubel Hossain comes back on.
Short and outside off, punched to cover for a single.
SIX! He knows what he can do, Miller! Fuller outside off, Miller stands his ground and lofts it over long off for a biggie. The hosts will want a lot more of these. 50-run stand up as well.

Well done Miller! Mahmdullah bowls it outside off, Miller comes down the wicket but gets an inside edge back towards the keeper. The ball comes slowly and Miller dives to get back into his crease. Shows how much he values his wicket.
Short and outside off, hit to sweeper cover for a single.
Flatter outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Shorter around middle, punched through mid-wicket for a single.
Mahmudullah comes on for a bowl.
Amla knocks one towards long on for a single. 16 runs off the over.
FOUR! And more! Darts it around middle, Amla waits for it and paddles it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. He is motoring along here.
FOUR! Amla's on the charge! Another poor ball, short outside off, Amla puts it away with a punch to the cover fence.
Rahim anticipates the sweep and gets across, Miller fails to connect but the ball goes off the back of the bat and loops over Rahim. A single taken towards short third man.
FOUR! Mistimed! Fuller in length, Miller comes down to go over the head of the bowler but gets it off the inner half. The long on fielder cannot cut it off and a boundary results.
Slides it around middle, Miller turns it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Mehedi Hasan returns for a burst.
FOUR! Top batting! Amla knows the length and just waits for it. Taskin bangs it short outside off, Hashim just ramps it past the keeper for a boundary. He is on 69 now!
Good length outside off, cracked off the back foot by Amla. Saifuddin slides to his left from sweeper cover and saves the boundary. 2 runs taken.
Back of a length outside off, Amla opens the face of the bat and guides it down to third man for a couple of runs.
Good length around middle, punched towards mid off for a single. 100 up for the home side.
Shorter length around off, Miller looks to turn it through the leg side but is hit on his body.
FOUR! Poor ball, punished! Length ball outside off, Miller is happy to stay back and punches it through covers for a boundary.
Taskin Ahmed called back on.
FOUR! In the gap! Good length outside off, Amla waits for it and spanks it between the short third man and backward point fielder for a boundary.
Amla tucks one through mid-wicket, wants two and gets the two runs.
Fuller length around off, Amla works one through the backward square leg region off the inner half. Good running gives them a couple of runs.
Good length around off, nudged towards square leg for a single.

The ball falls between three fielders! Fuller length outside off, Miller looks to go over cover but mistimes it. The ball lands in between three fielders coming towards it. From cover, mid off and sweeper cover.
Good length outside off, punched through covers for a single.
Full outside off, punched to the sweeper cover for a single.
Length ball outside off, Miller taps it towards point and Amla calls him through for a single. The fielder tries to run out Hashim but is ages late.
Tucks it through the square leg region for a single.
Drives it towards mid off for a single.

DROPPED! Shorter in length around leg, Miller looks to pull but manages to glove it. Rahim goes to his right, dives and looks to take it but the ball pops out of his hand at the last moment as he lands. How costly will it prove to be?

8th T20I fifty for Hashim Amla! Good length outside off, punched to sweeper cover for a single. It has been a solid knock by him but he will know that he has to carry on. 7th one for him in his last 12 innings.
Fuller in length around off, played back to the bowler by Miller.
David Miller walks in next.

OUT! What a catch, big wicket for Bangladesh! Full length from Saifuddin, de Villiers comes down and wants to send it over long off but has not timed it well. The ball goes straight to the fielder, Imrul Kayes who takes a good catch. That is a huge wicket and AB won't be happy. The bat turned in his hands while playing that shot. The cameo from de Villiers comes to an end. He was out in the same manner in the previous game too.
Full toss around off, AB de Villiers backs away and smashes it over the stumps at the other end for a couple of runs. He is trying to up the ante.
Shorter in length outside off, Amla guides one down to third man for a single.
Angles a fuller length ball around middle, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Good length outside off, AB is backing away and hence lets it go.
Another change! Mohammad Saifuddin comes on for a bowl.
FOUR! Crashed! Rubel goes a tad fuller, wider outside off, Amla does not miss out and sends it crashing to the point fence. Top shot.
Length ball outside off, punched to cover by the batsman.
Shorter in length outside off, slapped to the sweeper cover fielder again for a single. Good defensive bowling?
Back of a length outside off, dabbed down to third man for a run.
Short again outside off, slapped to sweeper cover for a single.
Short and outside off, Amla punches it to third man for a single.
Time for Rubel Hossain!
Flatter around middle, Amla goes back and turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Works it through mid-wicket for a single.

FOUR! Hit away! Full toss from Mehedi, AB de Villiers stays back and punches it through covers. The timing is pristine and he gets another boundary. So often it is AB who provides the impetus to the innings.
New ball please! That six from de Villiers has ensured that we don't have it back.
SIX! BOOM! Fuller outside off, de Villiers comes down and hits one out of South Africa. The timing was too good and he gets a biggie over mid-wicket. Superb, superb shot, that.
Shorter in length, worked towards square leg for a single.
FOUR! Smashed! Fuller outside off, Amla gets across and blasts it over the head of the bowler for a boundary. Good start to the over. 50 up for the home side.
Shorter in length, nudged towards mid-wicket for a single by Amla. End of a top spell by Shakib.
Lands it around off, Amla comes forward and blocks it.
Flatter outside off, cut hard to sweeper cover for a single.
Fuller outside off, driven off the front foot to covers.
Amla comes down and knocks it to long on for a single.
Loops it outside off, de Villiers punches it towards covers for a quick single. The throw at the striker's end is wide and it helps Hashim get in.
FOUR! Poor ball and punished! Flatter around leg, Amla stays in his crease and paddles it down to the fine leg fence for a boundary. Good end to the over for the home side.
Turns it towards mid on for a single.
Crowd catch! Fuller around off, de Villiers chips it back to the bowler. The crowd thinks it is a wicket and hence celebrate but they are brought to reality a moment later.
Flatter around off, worked through the same region for a single.
Fuller on middle, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller around off, clipped to long on for a single.
AB de Villiers is the new man in.

OUT! Two for Shakib! Bowls it flatter around the stumps, Duminy looks to sweep it but misses. The ball crashes into the leg stump and that is it for JP. The promotion does not work for the SA skipper and he is asked to go back to the hut by his counterpart. Good start for Bangladesh.
Plays one back to the bowler off his crease.
Fuller on middle, Duminy comes down and looks to go over the long off fence. Das runs back to take it from mid off but cannot get to it. That was a tough one to take. Two runs taken.
Turns it through mid-wicket for a single.
Amla comes down and nudges one back down the wicket.

FOUR! Sloppy! Short and outside off, Amla stands tall and punches it towards backward point. The fielder allows it to go through him and Hashim gets a boundary. Mahmudullah was the fielder there. Shakib is not impressed one bit.
Fuller on middle and leg, Duminy looks to go over mid-wicket but gets an inside edge onto his bat. Stifled appeal turned down.
Shorter outside off, cut towards point by the batsman.
Edged! Amla comes down to turn one through mid-wicket but extra bounce means he gets a leading edge towards backward point. A wild throw earns them a run.
Lands it around off, turned through mid-wicket for a single.
Duminy drives one through mid off for a single.
A tad flatter around middle, Amla punches it towards mid on for a single.
Bowling change! Mehedi Hasan comes on.
Hangs back to the shortish delivery and knocks it down to long on for a run. Brilliant over from Shakib, a wicket and two runs from it.
The Protea skipper uses his feet and works it past the short mid-wicket fielder for a run. He is off the mark.
Plays this one with the spin to mid-wicket.
JP Duminy strides out bat. He has promoted himself up the order, ahead of AB de Villiers.

OUT! The skipper draws first blood! Mosehle fails to make the opportunity count. Arm delivery, pitching and skidding off the  surface. Mangaliso tries to play it across but misses. The ball brushes his thigh pad and deflects back onto his stumps. He was late in playing that and pays the price.
Coming in with the arm, defended solidly off the front foot.
Confusion but no harm done! Tossed up delivery, Mosehle taps it to point and looks for a run but is rightly sent back.
SIX! First maximum of the innings! Short delivery on middle and leg, sits up nicely for Amla. He stands tall and pulls it with aplomb over Saifuddin at deep square leg for a biggie.
Angling into Mosehle who tucks it through square leg for a run.
Good fielding! Length delivery outside off, Amla flays it towards backward point where Rahman dives to his right and saves a certain boundary.

FOUR! There is very little margin for error when you are bowling to this guy. There was nothing wrong with this delivery but such is the class of Amla. Fullish delivery around off, Hashim shuffles across and clips it beautifully through mid-wicket to pick up another boundary.
Fuller length delivery, angling in from outside off. Hashim presses forward and defends it solidly to mid off.
Begins with a full length ball on middle, attacking the stumps. Amla clips it nicely to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
Taskin Ahmed to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! The execution was perfect there. Floated delivery, Mosehle makes room and goes inside out over extra cover to find the fence. 9 from the first over, good start for the Proteas.
Amla makes room and knocks this one down to long off for a run.
FOUR! South Africa are away in style! Tossed up delivery, Amla uses his feet and wrists it past short mid-wicket and the ball races to the fence.
Coming in with the arm, Amla looks to tuck it around the corner but misses to get hit on the thigh pad.
Stays back to the flatter delivery and defends it solidly.
Starts off with a short delivery around off, Amla rocks back and slaps it straight to the fielder at point.
Time for the game! The two South African openers for today Hashim Amla and Mangaliso Mosehle come out to bat. Bangladesh begin with Shakib Al Hasan. Here we go..
TOSS - Bangladesh win the toss and opt to field. Liton Das comes in for Shafiul Islam. Two changes for South Africa. Mosehle and Pretorius come in for de Kock and Paterson.

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the second and final T20I between South Africa and Bangladesh at the Senwes Park, Potchefstroom. The hosts have won everything and will aim to extend their domination. JP Duminy will hope for another good show from his men. The tourists on the other hand have been mentally absent for most part of this tour. They have often been playing conditions in their mind than on offer and it has cost them every single game. Can Shakib Al Hasan lead his troops to one final win before they leave? Stay tuned for the details from the toss.
